data.content_ref: inline:Prove an impossibility boundary: any monotone edge-construction enrichment that preserves determinism, polynomial cost, and committed-root validity cannot increase the set of accepted conjectures beyond the original grounded extension; therefore the only responsible strengthening is to enrich the vocabulary of defeat, e.g., typed attacks with side conditions, rather than the graph. Criticizable because the proof may rely on a too-restrictive definition of edge-construction and miss enrichment via annotations or proof certificates.
